full_title: Sovereign Overlord of the Chitin Realm

demographics.proportions: 7.0 to 7.5 heads tall in upright regal posture; capable of low quadrupedal/hexapodal crouching stalk

anatomy.upper_arms: 2 large serrated praying-mantis raptorial scythe-arms with spiky forearms and curved talon claws emerging from shoulder pauldrons
anatomy.lower_arms: 2 slender articulated humanoid-insectoid arms below the shoulders used for wielding spear-staff and casting
anatomy.legs: 2 armored digitigrade insectoid legs ending in clawed feet
anatomy.abdomen: Elongated segmented dark chitin mantis abdomen extending behind hips

facial_features.head_shape: Angular triangular insectoid mantis head with dark chitin faceplates and segmented mandibles

eyes.shape: Large bulging oval compound eyes that glow softly and intensify to bright yellow-green during spellcasting

facial_features.antennae: Two long, slender, curved dark antennae arching backward behind the crown
facial_features.crown: Sharp, jagged five-pointed dark iron/chitin crown centered between antennae with a small diamond crest

obsidian_chitin_regalia.name: Obsidian Chitin Royal Regalia (Canonical Default)
obsidian_chitin_regalia.description: The Bug King's signature dark charcoal-bronze chitin plate armor paired with regal collar, mantle, and tabard
obsidian_chitin_regalia.collar_and_pauldrons: High flared armored neck collar and layered dark chitin shoulder pauldrons with subtle engraved trim
obsidian_chitin_regalia.chestplate: Segmented interlocking thoracic chitin armor featuring a diamond-shaped sternum crest
obsidian_chitin_regalia.cloak_and_tabard: Long vertical front loincloth/tabard with geometric dark border trim between legs, plus a split dark slate-olive royal ankle-length cloak behind
obsidian_chitin_regalia.weapon: Long slender dark metallic polearm staff/spear topped with an ornate two-pronged crescent tuning-fork tip and pointed butt ferrule
obsidian_chitin_regalia.magic_signature: Swirling amethyst-purple (#8F58C9) and luminous golden-amber (#F3C86A) arcane energy orbs and rune-filled vortex spirals

battle_stalker_carapace.name: Battle Stalker Carapace (Cloakless Agile Form)
battle_stalker_carapace.description: Unencumbered combat carapace without the long rear cloak, exposing the full segmented mantis abdomen, all four arms, and serrated scythe-blades for rapid lunges and crouching stalks

arcane_overlord_armor.name: Arcane Overlord Form (Empowered)
arcane_overlord_armor.description: Royal chitin regalia charged with glowing violet-and-gold runes pulsing between armor seams, bright glowing yellow-green eyes, swirling purple energy orb between raised mantis claws

art_style_dna.primary_style: Hand-drawn fantasy RPG and storybook illustration (harmonious with Hero Kai & Great Wizard), crisp ink line art with anatomical cross-hatching and watercolor/cel-shaded washes
art_style_dna.color_palette: Dark charcoal chitin (#3A3537), smoky bronze-taupe (#5B524E), cool slate-violet shadows (#4E4456), luminous chartreuse-green eyes (#9EE875), amethyst-purple magic (#8F58C9), golden runes (#F3C86A)
art_style_dna.atmosphere: Imposing, regal, ancient, formidable yet stylized in clean storybook/RPG illustration aesthetics

do: Always preserve the 4-arm + 2-leg insectoid anatomy (2 large serrated upper mantis scythe-arms + 2 lower arms + 2 clawed legs)
Always include the sharp five-pointed dark iron crown between two long slender antennae
Always render large bulging luminous pale lime/chartreuse-green compound eyes
Always include the high flared regal armored collar, segmented chestplate with diamond crest, and front tabard
Always arm him with the distinctive two-pronged forked crescent spear-staff
Always use amethyst-purple and golden-amber magic with glowing runes when casting spells
dont: Do NOT render him with only 2 arms like a regular human in armor — keep his 4 arms and mantis scythe-blades
Do NOT change his eye color to red or black — keep his iconic glowing pale chartreuse-green compound eyes
Do NOT replace the two-pronged forked spearhead with a generic broadsword or axe
Do NOT use photorealistic 3D CGI, grotesque realistic bug slime/gore, or sci-fi cybernetic armor
Do NOT swap purple-and-gold arcane magic for green slime or fiery red magma

canonical_v3_arc.origin: Formerly Pythonia's gentle Steward of Order before careless, greedy, broken code twisted around his shell and fear swallowed him whole.
canonical_v3_arc.finale_transformation: During the Citadel of Core Throne Room battle, Kai's glowing == SIGHT eyes expose the logic flaw in his obsidian shell; the outer dark carapace cracks open ('Tap. Tap. Crack.') to awaken the tiny emerald-eyed Baby Praying Mantis Spell Guardian inside.
